## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title and commits follow the `[verb] action done` format
- [ ] The project builds successfully (`xmake`)
- [ ] All tests pass (`xmake test`)
- [ ] New features include tests / bug fixes include regression tests when possible
- [ ] Code is formatted with `clang-format` and has no new `clang-tidy` warnings
- [ ] Public APIs are documented following the Doxygen convention
- [ ] No new dependency was added without prior discussion
- [ ] Documentation has been updated if needed
